name: APFSDS 3BM59 Svinets-1 (Russia, 125 mm)
description: Depleted-uranium twin of Svinets-2: about 735 x 21 mm, ~1650 m/s (dimensions assumed equal to 3BM60; public estimates). The Tank check uses depleted-uranium density and constants; a simulation runs it as tungsten alloy (DU strength data not in the simulator yet).
